laws.rule: Inagua National Park: obtain written BNT authorisation to camp, including overnight stays in a vehicle or vessel, and remain in the assigned area. The marine sensitive zones prohibit fishing or taking or chasing organisms unless authorised. Hunting is subject to a separate BNT application and licence; do not treat either exception as general access permission.

local-law.note: Only the named BNT park or trust properties checked, not district-wide conduct or coastal fishing outside park boundaries. The 2022 bylaws include park-specific fishing and hunting exceptions; no blanket no-fishing claim is made. Admission and permit fee amounts not checked in this record.
